rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion to a legitimacy-preserving clarification that retains Hardison’s core (especially seniority-system protection) while rejecting the de minimis gloss and remanding under a “substantial, business-linked burden” standard. Alito is very likely to dissent on stare decisis/reliance grounds, with some chance of separate concurrences from Thomas or Gorsuch to press a more explicitly textualist/originalist critique of Hardison’s phrasing.
